reason: A web UI plugin that reviews files changed by an agent during a session and compares the workspace with HEAD, with explicit handling for incomplete tool-level change information.

summaries.zh: 在会话面板中集中展示 Agent 的文件改动，并提供工作区与 HEAD 的只读对照视图。
summaries.en: Adds a session panel that summarizes an agent’s file changes and provides a read-only comparison between the workspace and HEAD.

capabilities: Reads session projection data about agent file-writing tool calls
Displays session file changes and edit counts in a web interface
Compares the workspace with HEAD using a read-only git operation through a loopback POST endpoint
